title: EventBus nested payload mutation isolation contract

contract.deep_copy: Each listener receives a deep-copied event payload
contract.nested_dict_isolation: Mutations to nested dictionaries do not affect subsequent listeners
contract.nested_list_isolation: Mutations to nested list elements do not affect subsequent listeners
contract.nested_object_isolation: Mutations to nested objects do not affect subsequent listeners
contract.source_integrity: The original emit() payload remains unchanged
